source.declared_scope: French newspaper pages with zones, labels, reading order and article separation

selection.rule: sort integer row indices 0..432 by SHA-256(BBVLM-A48:<index>), take first 3

predeclared_measurements.layout: region count, class labels and bounding-box agreement where coordinates are present
predeclared_measurements.reading_order: pairwise precedence and consecutive-edge accuracy without exposing ordered IDs to the reader
predeclared_measurements.ocr: only if a provider transcription is present; diplomatic and retrieval views remain separate
predeclared_measurements.cost: image count, reader count and CPU time

model_policy: One blind Luna reader on opaque region IDs; Sol only after explicit ambiguity or structural failure.
